intro.title: Packaging Units & Conversion
intro.subtitle: Strip to tablet conversion ratios, pack size configuration, and fractional loose unit counter billing

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 2: Packaging Unit Setup and Conversion Ratios. In retail pharmacy, patients often buy partial strips, requiring precise unit conversion ratios.
In the Item Master, configure the primary purchase unit as Strip and the loose dispensing unit as Tablet, specifying the exact units per pack such as 10 or 15 tablets.
At the POS billing counter, when a customer requests just four tablets, simply enter four slash ten or toggle the loose unit mode directly on the item row.
MediFlow computes the exact fractional price automatically based on the master conversion ratio, eliminating cashier math and price discrepancies.
Inventory is accurately decremented by zero point four strips, guaranteeing zero audit discrepancy between warehouse purchases and retail counter sales.

outro.takeaway: Packaging Conversion: Define strip-to-tablet conversion factors so partial blister sales calculate exact prices and deduct inventory with decimal precision.
